name: wide-ruling-07-negative-never-matches-a-shorter-when
reference: spec 0.30 ruling 7: decode reads the bits as `uint` does (ruling 2 of 0.5); matching reads the entity's value as an unsigned 64-bit pattern; a negative value never matches a `when` shorter than 64 bits: -1 is 2^64-1, outside 0..255
